verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Helicone's AI Gateway supports image generation via models with native image output (helicone-docs-31), implying some multimodal handling, but there is no explicit documentation or example showing traces capturing images, audio, or file payloads in the UI or logs. missing for 10: explicit trace/session UI support for viewing image/audio/file content, audio input logging, file attachment capture, and any hands-on confirmation of multimodal trace rendering.
